purpose: Bounded development-only baseline generation/replay and all-phase cost feasibility. Six eligible INT C-model sanity replays are explicitly separate from later query-SAT counterexample replays. No novel method, distinguishing-success, speedup or independent-test claim.
semantics: Exactly N live rows per original table; unchanged original SQL and complete operational C. Not at-most-N or business-complete semantics.
preparation_charge_note: 10 seconds conservative reserve for author-side source/AST/hash/preparation commands, not measured CPU. Measured parent and every reaped child/probe charged separately from supervisor start.
selection: Previously exposed 21 source groups; design-time structural rule, not blind preregistered test. Fixed 4 groups, no replacements.
failure_denominator: 12 registered cells. All front-end/refused/unknown/timeout/not-run retained; no automatic retry or enlargement.
promotion: This experiment cannot promote a new method; actual SAT export+full independent C+original-query replay is required for generated-witness claim. UNSAT is exact-N official encoding only.
stopping: Any supervisor resource/probe/integrity failure stops remainder. Query UNKNOWN retained. No increase in bounds/time budget after outcomes.
control_scope: For dev03_10 and dev03_15 at each exact bound, export the same validated C-check model, independently verify full operational C and execute identical original SQL. Always label C_MODEL_SANITY_ONLY_NOT_QUERY_SAT; no influence on official later query-SAT classification. All costs charged.
